title: Separate rendering thread has "ERROR: This function (finalize) can only be called from the render thread." message on shutdown
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.1, v4.7-beta1

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 127.7 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When enabling (experimental) separate rendering thread mode, the shutdown does unsafe cleanup per the `ERR_RENDER_THREAD_GUARD`:

```cpp
void RenderingDevice::finalize() {
	ERR_RENDER_THREAD_GUARD();  // <--- emits error message on shutdown
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable separate rendering mode
2. Run project and then close it
3. Observe message

```
Godot Engine v4.7.beta1.official.1c8cc9e7e - https://godotengine.org
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
WARNING: The separate rendering thread feature is experimental. Feel free to try it since it will eventually become a stable feature.
However, bear in mind that at the moment it can lead to project crashes or instability.
So, unless you want to test the engine, set the "rendering/driver/threads/thread_model" project setting to 'Safe'.
     at: setup2 (main/main.cpp:3493)

ERROR: This function (finalize) can only be called from the render thread.
   at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:8823)
WARNING: 2 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit (run with `--verbose` for details).
   at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2535)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[separate-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27134172/separate-repro.zip)
